name: Caddy Manager
description: Self-hosted Caddy reverse proxy and site management panel with safe config validation.

caddyBinary.label: Caddy Binary
caddyBinary.description: Absolute path to the Caddy executable used to validate and reload configurations.

mainConfig.label: Main Caddyfile
mainConfig.description: Absolute path to the main Caddyfile, which imports the site snippets.

snippetDir.label: Site Snippet Directory
snippetDir.description: Absolute path to the directory containing active site Caddyfile snippets.

sitesRoot.label: Sites Root Directory
sitesRoot.description: Absolute path to the parent directory used for new static site roots.

serviceUnit.label: Systemd Service Unit
serviceUnit.description: Name of the Caddy systemd service unit used for status, service actions, and journal logs.

logLines.label: Default Log Lines
logLines.description: Default number of recent log lines to read per request (100–2000).

certProbeHours.label: Certificate Probe Cache Duration
certProbeHours.description: Number of hours to cache TLS certificate probe results (1–168).

metricsPeriodic.label: Periodic Metrics Snapshots
metricsPeriodic.description: Collect a runtime metrics snapshot every 60 seconds when enabled.

backupKeep.label: Backup Retention Count
backupKeep.description: Maximum number of configuration backups to retain (10–1000).

zh-CN.name: Caddy 管理
zh-CN.description: 自托管的 Caddy 运维面板，提供站点表单、配置校验、证书探测与安全热重载。

caddyBinary.label: Caddy 可执行文件
caddyBinary.description: 用于校验和热重载配置的 Caddy 可执行文件的绝对路径。

mainConfig.label: 主 Caddyfile
mainConfig.description: 用于导入各站点配置片段的主 Caddyfile 的绝对路径。

snippetDir.label: 站点片段目录
snippetDir.description: 存放已启用站点的 Caddyfile 配置片段的目录绝对路径。

sitesRoot.label: 站点根目录
sitesRoot.description: 新建静态站点根目录所在的父目录的绝对路径。

serviceUnit.label: systemd 服务单元
serviceUnit.description: Caddy 的 systemd 服务单元名称，用于查询状态、管理服务和读取日志。

logLines.label: 默认日志行数
logLines.description: 每次请求默认读取的最近日志行数（100–2000）。

certProbeHours.label: 证书探测缓存时长
certProbeHours.description: TLS 证书探测结果的缓存时长，以小时为单位（1–168）。

metricsPeriodic.label: 定期采集运行指标
metricsPeriodic.description: 启用后每 60 秒采集一次运行指标快照。

backupKeep.label: 备份保留数量
backupKeep.description: 保留配置备份的最大数量（10–1000）。
